paragraphs: An outbreak of E. coli O26 linked to raw milk cheese has ended, according to the FDA [16]. The outbreak sickened 18 people across 10 states, with 9 hospitalizations and no deaths [1]. The outbreak was traced to Sierra Nevada Graziers grass-fed raw milk cheeses [16].

Multiple breakfast sandwich and sausage products are being recalled due to Listeria contamination [2][3][5]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC recalled its 9.5 oz Biscuit & Sausage Gravy product sold in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas [2]. The company expanded this recall on November 17 to include Fresh To You brand sausage, egg & cheese biscuit sandwiches and Meals Made in Minutes brand biscuit & sausage gravy [5]. Additionally, Grand Strand Sandwich Company recalled four Lunch Box biscuit products due to Listeria monocytogenes contamination [3]. If you purchased these products, do not eat them and discard them or return them to the store [2][3][5].

Other recalls this week include ALDI's Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni due to potential botulism risk from improper storage temperatures [6]. Naia Inc. recalled Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto with certain code dates because they may contain undeclared tree nuts, milk, and eggs [7]. Larbi Inc. recalled Herb To Body Yellow Dock Root C/S 4oz due to possible Salmonella contamination [4].
